QuestInfo.name: Floating Lotus
QuestInfo.0: Looks like #b#p1401001##k has the results from the investigation into #p1404005#.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p1401001#, the #b#m310000000# Power Plant#k is the central hub of the Black Wings' mining operations. Furthermore, she believes that Orchid's Room is buried deep inside. #p1404005#'s body must be there!
QuestInfo.2: #p1404005# is trapped inside a glass chamber. It's not the most sporting way to beat your foe, but you know better than to let a good opportunity go to waste.
